timeline_highlights.title: Trial Begins in Germany for Ukrainian Accused of Nord Stream Pipeline Bombing
timeline_highlights.summary: A trial has commenced in Hamburg for Serhii Kuznetsov, a former Ukrainian army officer accused of orchestrating the 2022 explosions of the Nord Stream gas pipelines. Supporters gathered outside the court, waving Ukrainian flags in solidarity. The case raises questions about Ukraine's involvement in the sabotage of the pipelines, which were critical for Russian gas supplies to Germany.
key_facts: Trial of Serhii Kuznetsov begins in Hamburg.
Kuznetsov is accused of leading a plot to destroy the Nord Stream pipelines.
Supporters gathered outside the court in solidarity with Kuznetsov.
